best_idea: Resolve each map cell to one colour by a fixed priority (monster over item over floor), add an unexplored-frontier colour, and fit the cell size to the free space, so a zone minimap reads on a 375 px phone.
decision_why: Keep the priority-resolved cell colour, the frontier marker and the safe tap-to-travel rule for the zone minimap; fix the donor's dead cloud category, dead monster colours and zero-size placement first; the 80 x 70 grid is one level's size and becomes zone data.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone a seen item on a floor cell shows the item colour, a detected unseen monster shows the hostile colour, an unknown cell next to known floor shows the frontier colour; a tap on an adjacent cell acts on it, a tap on a far cell in a safe zone starts travel, and a tap on a far cell when the safety test fails takes one step; a unit test asserts each category.
